name: Xiaochu
summary: Jingchu Xiaochu is a compact humanoid robot for teaching and cultural-tourism companionship. Its upper body has a head and two arms, while articulated wheel legs support movement, crouching, waving and dancing. The manufacturer describes binocular depth sensing for navigation and an AI voice module for conversation, with an optional gripper for simple tasks. It is officially listed as a product and was exhibited at WRC 2026; delivery terms are not verified.
